definitions.explanation: A fight or argument between people.

examples.japanese: {友達|ともだち}と{喧嘩|けんか}した。
examples.english: I had a fight with my friend.

notes:
{喧嘩|けんか} is a noun/suru-verb for quarrels, arguments, or fights.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {喧嘩|けんか}をする (to fight/quarrel)
- {喧嘩|けんか}になる (to turn into a fight)
- 〜と{喧嘩|けんか}する (fight with ~)
- {喧嘩|けんか}を{売|う}る (to pick a fight)
- {喧嘩|けんか}を{買|か}う (to accept a challenge)

RELATED WORDS:
- {口喧嘩|くちげんか}: verbal argument
- {夫婦喧嘩|ふうふげんか}: marital fight

Note: Often written in hiragana (けんか) in casual contexts.
